review_summary: Comprehensive Review (Chidzidzo 63) consolidates Lessons 57, 58, 59, 60, 61, 62. Key structures mastered in this block include Zezuru alliterative subject/object concords (zvivakashure), agglutinative tense/aspect markers (-no- habitual, -ka- past, -cha- future), and high/low tone patterns across: 1st Person Sg Negative Concord (handi-); Mupanda 5/9 Nominal or Verbal Stem; Mupanda 15/17 Prefix (ku-); Mupanda 1/3/18 Prefix (mu-). Example utterances reviewed: "handidi zvangu kuita mumwe mwana zvaizvezvi saka ndandichida kubvunza kuti ndedzipi nzira dzandingashandisa kudzivirira kuti ndisabata pamuviri" | "zvinotenderwa here kuti mudzimai akazvitakura, ane 8 months akazvitakura asangane nemurume pabonde zvinenge zviri safe here kumudzimai akazvitakura uyu" | "nhova yemwana yakanyanyisa kunyurira mukati ane problem here or patone certain medication yandotofanha kutomutsvagira kuti nhova yake isanyanyise kunyura"

review_exercises.prompt: Complete the Zezuru sentence: 'handidi zvangu kuita mumwe mwana zvaizvezvi saka ndandichida kubvunza kuti ndedzipi nzira dzandingashandisa kudzivirira kuti ndisabata ______' (Zezuru utterance (I do not [di] / zvangu / to (infinitive) / towards [ita] / person / singular / inside [mwe] / child / zvaizvezvi / saka / I have [ndichida]))
review_exercises.explanation: 'pamuviri' completes the clause with the proper Zezuru lexical and tonal pattern.

review_exercises.prompt: Complete the Zezuru sentence: 'zvinotenderwa here kuti mudzimai akazvitakura, ane 8 months akazvitakura asangane nemurume pabonde zvinenge zviri safe here kumudzimai akazvitakura ______' (Zezuru utterance (things / manner [notenderwa] / here / to (infinitive) / towards [ti] / person / singular / inside [dzimai] / he/she did [zvitakura] / ane / 8 / months))
review_exercises.explanation: 'uyu' completes the clause with the proper Zezuru lexical and tonal pattern.

review_exercises.prompt: Complete the Zezuru sentence: 'nhova yemwana yakanyanyisa kunyurira mukati ane problem here or patone certain medication yandotofanha kutomutsvagira kuti nhova yake isanyanyise ______' (Zezuru utterance (nhova / yemwana / it (Cl. 9) did [nyanyisa] / to (infinitive) / towards [nyurira] / person / singular / inside [kati] / ane / problem / here))
review_exercises.explanation: 'kunyura' completes the clause with the proper Zezuru lexical and tonal pattern.

review_exercises.prompt: Complete the Zezuru sentence: 'mwana wangu haasi kudya ______ kwemazuva ndirikunetsekana kuti chii chikange chiri kuita kuti asadye zvakanaka uyezve angabatsirika sei kuti adyewo zvakanaka' (Parent's pediatric inquiry in Zezuru: 'mwana wangu haasi kudya zvakanaka kwemazuva ndirikunetsekana kuti chii chikange ')
review_exercises.explanation: 'zvakanaka' completes the clause with the proper Zezuru lexical and tonal pattern.

review_exercises.prompt: Complete the Zezuru sentence: 'nhumbu yangu yava kusvika 9 months saka ndanga ndichida kuziva kuti unoziva sei kuti labor yatanga pane zvinobuda ______ pane chaunonzwa here' (Expectant mother's health inquiry in Zezuru: 'nhumbu yangu yava kusvika 9 months saka ndanga ndichida kuziva kuti unoziva sei ')
review_exercises.explanation: 'here' completes the clause with the proper Zezuru lexical and tonal pattern.

review_exercises.prompt: Complete the Zezuru sentence: 'ndakazvitakura asi ndukurutsa zvakanyanya ndukunetsekanazve kuti aah chii chingange chiri kundinetsa chii chingange chakanganisika pandiri zvakutondi shungurudza ______' (I am pregnant and vomiting constantly; I am worried and would like advice on what to do.)
review_exercises.explanation: 'ini' completes the clause with the proper Zezuru lexical and tonal pattern.
